name: Agentic OS — Full Orchestration Stack
description: Production agentic orchestration stack: Ollama inference + LibreChat agent frontend + Qdrant vector memory + Redis task queue + LiteLLM multi-provider routing. All LLM endpoints point to localhost — no external API keys needed.
author: ai-lsc

notes.architecture: The agents/ package bridges LibreChat's function-calling to AI-LSC's RuntimeExecutor. The LLM can start/stop services, pull models, and inject skills through natural language.
notes.model_routing: LiteLLM proxy at localhost:4000 normalizes all local Ollama models into a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Ollama serves at localhost:11434. LiteLLM config points: model_list: [{model_name: 'qwen2.5', litellm_params: {model: 'ollama/qwen2.5:32b', api_base: 'http://localhost:11434/v1'}}].
notes.memory_layers: Redis (localhost:6379) = hot path (task queue, pub/sub, status cache). MariaDB = cold path (audit logs, persisted memory, config). Qdrant (localhost:6333) = semantic index (RAG, skill matching, vector search).
notes.agent_frontend: LibreChat at localhost:3080 provides multi-provider support with native OpenAI tool-calling format. Configure it to point at LiteLLM as the assistant endpoint.
notes.workflow: n8n at localhost:5678 orchestrates complex multi-step agent workflows beyond single-turn tool calls.
